!2 PDF
Binary's PDF first page is converted to different image sizes. 
 
The formats of the images are :
 * '''thumbnail''': small image in jpg format. Fixed width 200px, height relative to the original.
 * '''record''': large thumbnail (displayed on the post card) jpg format. Fixed width 600px, height relative to the original.
 * '''preview''': medium-sized image in jpg format. Fixed width 1200px, height relative to the original.
 
 * '''Case 1:''' It must be possible to upload and convert a PDF
 * '''Case 2:''' Some PDFs contain content that is larger than what is visible on the page. In these cases, the system must use the PDF CropBox so that only the visible part of the first page is converted.
 * '''Case 3:''' Because Case 2 is implemented, the system must also handle PDFs where the first page contains only a logo or other content on a white page. In these cases, the visible page area must be preserved and must not be cropped too aggressively.

!***> '''Case 1''' PDF
!define originalFileName {aPdf.pdf}
!define expectedChecksumSha512 {edd61d83b20c9d49d6caad7175a3817ded3c5c4552df70b816bba8fcd3b17f862dde8781753ebe9d3691f3b5ebbb7b22927dc023f36dbdc526068091a095ed77}
